name: r7-auth-utf8-scoped
description: TEXT values holding invalid UTF-8 (user_uuid with unknown and colliding decodings, zone_uuid with a policy and a grant, device and zone names, gateway EUI): node-sqlite3 decodes with replacement and binds the decoded string. Record --scoped.

steps.sql: SELECT id, typeof(user_uuid) AS t, hex(user_uuid) AS h FROM users WHERE id BETWEEN 220 AND 229 ORDER BY id
SELECT deveui, hex(name) AS name, hex(gateway_device_eui) AS gw, user_id FROM devices WHERE deveui IN ('A840410000009F01','A8404100000080E4') ORDER BY deveui
SELECT command_type, result, device_eui, json_extract(result_detail,'$.reason') AS reason FROM applied_commands ORDER BY applied_at, device_eui
SELECT hex(user_uuid) AS u, hex(zone_uuid) AS z FROM user_zone_assignments ORDER BY created_at, assignment_uuid
